name: John Hoeven

issue_poll.name: Pew Research Center national survey of registered voters, Oct 10–16, 2022
issue_poll.note: No public 2022 North Dakota poll ranking issues was found (a 1892 Polling ND survey named inflation and government spending as top issues but published no figures). Ranked by Pew's national 'very important' share: economy 79%, education 64%, health care 63%, energy 61%, violent crime 61%, elections/voting 58%, gun policy 57%, abortion 56%, immigration 54%, foreign policy 54%. Skipped 'future of democracy' (no vote can test it) and Supreme Court appointments (no vacancy this term).

issues.position: Cut federal spending; require balanced budgets
issues.note: No balanced-budget amendment got a floor vote; scored on the $9B rescissions bill (51-48, only Collins and Murkowski among Republicans opposed).

issues.position: Oppose Biden student loan debt cancellation

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of the student loan debt relief rule (CRA)
votes.question: On passage

issues.note: Hoeven's June 1, 2023 release confirms his Yea vote (https://www.hoeven.senate.gov/?p=11188).

issues.position: More competition and price transparency; oppose socialized medicine
End the federal oil and gas moratorium; resume lease sales
issues.note: H.R.1 required regular onshore and offshore oil and gas lease sales.

issues.position: Enforce existing laws; keep repeat offenders off the streets
Oppose federal control of how states run elections
issues.note: The SAVE America Act sets a federal proof-of-citizenship rule for registration; his 2022 stance said the states, not Washington, should set election rules.

issues.position: Oppose red-flag laws and new burdens on lawful gun owners
Oppose abortion; supports some form of federal ban

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed
Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: No federal abortion ban got a floor vote this term.

issues.position: Keep Title 42; restart border wall construction
issues.note: H.R.1 funded border wall construction; Title 42 ended in May 2023 without a Senate floor vote to extend it.

votes.bill_title: National Security Supplemental (Ukraine, Israel, Taiwan aid)
votes.question: On passage

issues.note: Minot Daily News reported his Yea on the 70-29 passage (https://www.minotdailynews.com/news/local-news/2024/02/nd-senators-vote-for-security-act/).

caveats: No ranked 2022 North Dakota issue poll was found, so the issue list comes from national Pew data.
No campaign issue page or questionnaire was found; positions come from a Grand Forks Herald candidate guide, 2022 Senate releases and news coverage.
Elections is scored Contradicted on the SAVE America Act, the same way as ks-moran; his 2022 statement didn't mention voter ID or proof of citizenship.

Roll call numbers missing for H.R.4 (July 17, 2025) and H.R.815 passage (Feb 13, 2024). Numbers 135, 171, 211, 11 and 372 come from other researched files, not Hoeven-specific sources. His votes on H.J.Res.44 and S.4554 are inferred from party-line reporting.
